newsitem.title: CHINA: Rhone-Poulenc eyes 15 new China ventures.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc eyes 15 new China ventures.

text.p: French pharmaceutial and chemical giant Rhone-Poulenc SA is negotiating with several Chinese partners to establish 15 new joint ventures in China, the China Daily said on Saturday.
Joint venture agreements for the projects were expected to be signed over the next two years, Aldo Salvador, president of Rhone-Poulenc China, was quoted by the newspaper as saying.
He did not give a figure or elaborate on the planned projects.

Citing reasons for Rhone-Poulenc's decision to boost its investment in China, Salvador said: "The fundamentals of China have never been so good: high GDP growth, inflation under control, positive trade balance, $100 billion (foreign exchange) reserve."
By the end of 1996, Rhone-Poulenc had 13 joint ventures and one wholly-owned company in China with a total commitment of nearly $300 million.
